August 18, 2026

White House lashes out over questions about Trump aide Natalie Harp

tags: politics, media
sources: @aaronparnas, @total.hypocrisy

Reporting drawn from a Michael Wolff book says Natalie Harp, a 35-year-old aide to Donald Trump, spent a summer sleeping in a maid's room at the Bedminster golf club after being denied a room there, in order to stay close to him. Senator Jon Ossoff raised Trump's travel with Harp publicly, prompting White House Communications Director Steven Cheung to call the senator a "cuck loser" in an official statement. After CNN's Kristen Holmes asked about the relationship, the White House issued a statement invoking her children, and Trump attacked her in the Oval Office when she asked about his relationship with Kim Jong-un. Additional reporting says Harp is referred to as "the human printer" and that Melania Trump, who has appeared publicly very little in 2026, is unhappy with Harp's constant presence.

Iran warns it could strike US naval blockade if Hormuz diplomacy fails

tags: war, iran
sources: @oafnation_actual

Iran said it could attack the US naval blockade if diplomatic efforts over the Strait of Hormuz break down. The warning was tied to ongoing negotiations over access through the strait.

Supreme Court denies Trump appeal in E. Jean Carroll case

tags: legal, politics
sources: @aaronparnas

The Supreme Court declined to hear Donald Trump's appeal in the E. Jean Carroll case, leaving the sexual abuse verdict against him standing. The same day, the administration's record in election-related litigation was cited as 21 losses in 21 cases, with federal judges striking down each attempt to make voting harder. The White House also faced questions over the Natalie Harp reporting and further food recalls.

Border wall construction in Big Bend National Park put on hold

tags: environment, immigration, politics
sources: @carolinegleich

Customs and Border Protection's leader said all construction inside Big Bend National Park is on hold pending his own inspection, roughly two weeks after bulldozers reached a point a few hundred yards from Santa Elena Canyon. The work proceeded under the Trump administration's waiver of dozens of environmental laws, described as the first such waiver inside a national park. Opposition included sheriffs from both parties, a letter signed by 46 Texas lawmakers, and a lawsuit brought by Indigenous leaders, community members and a river outfitter. The environmental waivers remain in place and the pause is not a cancellation.

Florida woman jailed for seven months after Flock camera misidentified her car

tags: surveillance, legal, policing
sources: @aaronparnas

Lindsay Isaacs is taking legal action after a Flock automated license plate camera wrongly identified her Dodge Durango as the vehicle in a hit-and-run that killed three people in Florida. Police arrested her, impounded her vehicle and charged her with seven felonies carrying a potential life sentence. The camera identification was incorrect.

Russian strike kills 10 in Kharkiv as Moscow reports 620 Ukrainian drones

tags: war, defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

A Russian strike killed 10 people in Kharkiv. Moscow said Ukraine launched 620 drones toward the Russian capital.

Hegseth weighs presidential run with Iowa trip

tags: politics, elections
sources: @aaronparnas

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is considering a run for president and is travelling to Iowa, the first Republican caucus state, in a personal rather than official capacity, according to the Washington Post. Hegseth is a former Fox News host. A bid could complicate Trump's reported preference for a Vance–Rubio ticket and force him to endorse against his own defense secretary.

Florida Republican official arrested on child sex abuse charges

tags: legal, politics
sources: @aaronparnas

Michael Caruso, the Palm Beach County clerk and a senior Florida Republican allied with Governor Ron DeSantis, was arrested by Florida law enforcement on five felony counts. The charges include kidnapping, lewd and lascivious exhibition, luring or enticing a child, lewd or lascivious molestation, and child abuse causing mental injury. DeSantis suspended Caruso immediately. Full details of the circumstances have not been released.

Navy contract could push Tomahawk output past 1,000 missiles a year

tags: defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

A new Navy contract could raise Tomahawk missile production from roughly 60 missiles a year to more than 1,000.

Lavrov says Russia and North Korea are building a new world order

tags: politics, defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said Russia and North Korea are building a "new and righteous world order."

Senate bill would grant special operations veterans nationwide concealed carry

tags: legal, defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

A Senate bill would give qualified special operations veterans concealed-carry privileges valid nationwide.

Trump orders Navy back to steam catapults for future carrier

tags: defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

Donald Trump has ordered the Navy to revert to steam catapults for the future aircraft carrier USS Doris Miller.

Army awards helicopter flight school contract worth up to $10 billion

tags: defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

The Army has selected a contractor to overhaul its future helicopter pilot training under an agreement potentially worth up to $10 billion.

Navy offers surface warfare officers up to $150,000 retention bonus

tags: defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

The Navy is offering some surface warfare officers up to $150,000 to stay in service and take department head assignments at sea.

Army reservist sues OPM over differential pay rules

tags: legal, defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

An Army reservist is suing the Office of Personnel Management over differential-pay rules for federal employees. The Supreme Court rejected the rules last year.

Released Fauci emails show FDA official raised vaccine adverse event concerns

tags: health, politics
sources: @ericmoutsos

Senators Rand Paul and Ron Johnson are reviewing 34,000 text messages, 522 voicemails and emails released from Anthony Fauci. One May 27, 2021 email from then-FDA Commissioner Janet Woodcock told Fauci she had been contacted by a number of people, many of them healthcare professionals, reporting adverse events after COVID-19 vaccination from all three available vaccines, and that no one was taking them seriously or studying the reports. Fauci forwarded the message saying "we cannot ignore her" and suggested bringing in the CDC.

Army soldier builds wearable drone detector for under $120

tags: tech, defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

An Army soldier built a wearable counter-drone detection device using less than $120 in parts.
